# MIDI fixtures

Shared corpus for the backend import tests (`tests/backend/storage.test.ts`)
and the app converter tests (`app/tests/`).

| File | Origin | Exercises |
|---|---|---|
| `c-major-scale.mid` | app/public/midi-files (Jamie) | baseline single track |
| `twinkle.mid` | public-domain melody, in-house file | multi-measure melody, 4/4 |
| `bach_prelude.mid` | Mutopia Project (public domain), BWV 846 | 2 tracks, 546 notes, real-world timing |
| `synth_*.mid` | generated by `generate.mjs` | 3/4 + tempo change, 6/8 triplets/32nds, overlapping polyphony, 800 notes + drums, extreme pitches / zero duration, leading silence in 5/4, flat key |

Regenerate the synthetic files with `node tests/fixtures/midi/generate.mjs`.
